comment: Known-good shape for an execution plan. Mirrors TS CorePromptExecutionPlan (coreBridge.ts), which is embedded in CorePromptSubmissionResult.plan and emitted as a 'plan_update' stream event. Each step is CorePromptPlanStep (step_id/title/detail/surface/action_kind/requires_user_approval/target_url?). All fields snake_case — the Rust side serializes execution-plan DTOs as serde_json::json! with snake_case keys.

payload.title: Deploy the landing page
payload.summary: Build the static assets, push to the CDN, and verify the live URL.

steps.title: Build static assets
steps.detail: Run the production build and capture the dist/ output.

steps.title: Publish to CDN
steps.detail: Upload dist/ to the configured edge origin.
